         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies

  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 3.810 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id

  )

  -- of defense.

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.

          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id

    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.548 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.049 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id
                          from public.commissions c
                          join public.hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id
                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'hospital' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id from public.hospitals h where h.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select c.hospital_id from public.commissions c where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    else false
  end;

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select exists (
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

    from public.profiles p

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.

  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

    )
  end;

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies

Query Text: 
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 3.846 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code

  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

  end;

  select case

  end;

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

  end;

  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role

      and case p_scope_type

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.

          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

  end;

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id

     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())

    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.392 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.036 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id
                          from public.commissions c
                          join public.hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id
                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'hospital' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id from public.hospitals h where h.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select c.hospital_id from public.commissions c where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    else false
  end;

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

  );

     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

    from public.profiles p

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.

  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies

Query Text: 
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end

   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 5.785 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code

  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id

                          join public.hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id
                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id from public.hospitals h where h.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select c.hospital_id from public.commissions c where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    else false
  end;

  end;

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

      and m.role = p_role

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         rp.permission_code,

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.

          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

    else false
  end;

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.409 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.030 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id
                          from public.commissions c
                          join public.hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id
                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'hospital' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id from public.hospitals h where h.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select c.hospital_id from public.commissions c where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    else false
  end;

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

  select exists (
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

           when 'organization' then m.organization_id

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.

         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 4.518 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

  end;

  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies

Query Text: 
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 3.871 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code

  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id

                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id from public.hospitals h where h.id = p_assignment_id)

      p_requested_id = (select c.hospital_id from public.commissions c where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    else false
  end;

  select case

    )
  end;

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

      and m.role = p_role

      and case p_scope_type

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code

      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id

    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  );

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.273 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:574: LOG:  duration: 0.080 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id
                          from public.commissions c
                          join public.hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id
                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'hospital' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id from public.hospitals h where h.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select c.hospital_id from public.commissions c where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    else false
  end;

    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.principal_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = p_role
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
      and case p_scope_type
            when 'organization' then m.organization_id = p_scope_id
            when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id     = p_scope_id
            when 'commission'   then m.commission_id   = p_scope_id
            else false
          end
  )
  -- IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (not `=`) is the real fix (BUG-ACT-NULLHAT-1) --
  -- see the module-level comment above for why the exists() clause above is
  -- ALSO incidentally NULL-safe, but must not be relied on as a second line
  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());
